name: Halva (Wheat-based)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Heat the margarine very gently in a saucepan. Add the flour, and cook for 40 minutes over low to moderate heat until golden brown.
When the flour turns light golden, combine the sugar and water in a separate saucepan. Boil gently to make a syrup.
Add the syrup to the saucepan with flour, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Scoop out small portions of halva with a wooden spoon, form into balls, and place on a serving plate.

culture.text: Halva is a type of confectionery that is found throughout North Africa, East Africa, Eastern Europe, the Balkans, West Asia, Central Asia, South Asia, and the Levant. The name refers to a broad variety of recipes, generally a thick paste made from flour, butter, oil, saffron, rosewater, milk, turmeric powder, and sugar.
